name: application-toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: Page or section header row with a title, optional description, and a set of typed action buttons for common admin and dashboard headers.
useWhen: Heading a page or section that needs one or more primary actions, such as Invite, Export, or Create.
Establishing a consistent title/description/actions row across list, table, or settings pages.
Replacing a hand-rolled flex row of a heading and buttons with a typed, reusable primitive.
avoidWhen: The page needs breadcrumbs or multi-level navigation — use a dedicated navigation component instead.
There are more than two or three actions — collapse extras into a menu instead of a long button row.
The heading has no actions at all — a plain heading element is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The title and actions stack vertically on narrow screens and align into a single row at the sm breakpoint and above; the action row wraps if it does not fit on one line.
accessibility: The title renders as a real heading element so the toolbar contributes to the page's heading structure.
Each action is a real button element with visible text, not an icon-only control without a label.

variants.title: Toolbar
variants.description: Title, optional description, and a row of typed actions rendered as real buttons with click handlers.
accessibility: Primary and secondary actions are visually distinct through contrast, not color alone.

variants.title: Toolbar (Dark)
variants.description: Title, description, and action row adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Title, description, and button text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
